name: Code with .NET, Node.js, Claude, Rust, Codex CLI
initializeCommand:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .devcontainer "$HOME/.claude" "$HOME/.codex"; if [ ! -f .devcontainer/.env ]; then printf "# GitHub CLI token (for gh API; git over SSH uses your SSH key)
GH_TOKEN=

# AI keys (only if you actually use them in this container)
OPENAI_API_KEY=
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
" > .devcontainer/.env; fi; chmod 600 .devcontainer/.env; grep -qxF ".devcontainer/.env" .gitignore || echo ".devcontainer/.env" >> .gitignore; [ -f .devcontainer/post-create-command.sh ] && chmod +x .devcontainer/post-create-command.sh || true; SOCK="${SSH_AUTH_SOCK:-}"; for H in "$HOME" "/home/vscode" "/home/canuszczyk"; do [ -d "$H" ] || continue; mkdir -p "$H/.ssh"; if [ -n "$SOCK" ] && [ -S "$SOCK" ]; then ln -snf "$SOCK" "$H/.ssh/agent.sock"; else rm -f "$H/.ssh/agent.sock"; fi; done'
postCreateCommand: bash -lc "mkdir -p ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.local && npm install -g pnpm@10.8.1 --prefix ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.local || true; bash ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/.devcontainer/post-create-command.sh"
